}}Game of Thrones: The Mad King is an upcoming stage play by Duncan Macmillan. It is a prequel to the epic high fantasy novel series A Song of Ice and Fire by George R. R. Martin.
Production
On 18 February 2026, it was announced that the play will be presented by the Royal Shakespeare Company have its world premiere at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre in Stratford-upon-Avon, directed by Dominic Cooke. Previews will begin on 20 July 2026 with an opening night on 8 August, running until 5 September. Booking will open in April 2026, with full details to be announced.
The play is set 10 years before A Game of Thrones, amidst a tournament at Harrenhal. Members of the inner circle of the titular Mad King Aerys II plot against him, as fears grow about his accelerating ruthlessness.
